parameters.name: githubToken
parameters.description: GitHub PAT with 'repo' scope. Alternatively set GITHUB_TOKEN env var.

parameters.name: claudeApiKey
parameters.description: Anthropic API key for claude-sonnet-4-20250514. Alternatively set CLAUDE_API_KEY env var.

parameters.name: discordWebhookUrl
parameters.description: Discord webhook URL for delivery. Alternatively set DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL env var.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language for the generated summary (EN/FR). Alternatively set SUMMARY_LANGUAGE env var.

parameters.name: fromEmail
parameters.description: Sender email address (requires email node configuration)

parameters.name: toEmail
parameters.description: Recipient email address (requires email node configuration)
